newsitems.title: Athanasia Coming To Early Access
newsitems.author: Safavi
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone, we have some exciting news for you all today. Athanasia will be coming to Early Access this October 19th. You can watch our Early Access trailer on Gamespot channel today at 8am PT / 12pm ESTThis will include the first half of the game. With the remaining half under development as of this moment and will be during the remainder of the Early Access period. Our early access will include several areas to explore, unique tools, weapons and creatures. There will be lots to explore and overcome in the halls of the SAIR facility, do you think you will survive?Why Early Access? How long will we be in it? Great questions, for starters Early Access period will allow us to present what we already have the game and get valuable feedback from our players. As we want the most fun and polished experience possible. Secondly our Early Access period wont be super long, we understand some worries about "forever" Early Access games and we want to ensure you that the second half of the game is already being made, and if all goes well we would like to leave Early Access sometime in 2027. Nothing is guaranteed but we feel confident about this projection. As for our price we are going to be launching at a to be decided price, with a price increase on release. Thank you for your continued support!We hope to see you in October to celebrate our release!!

newsitems.title: Demo Update!
newsitems.author: Safavi
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone for this months update we are finally ready to publish a really massive update for the demo. We have been hard at work with a multitude of bug fixes and everyone will get a preview of one the dinosaurs from the next area of the game as well! Patch Notes: -Added preview of Coelophysis in main venue -Fixed detection issues with certain items -Map displays and med cabinets have been updated -Radio lines will now que instead of cutting off -Fix soft lock issue in tutorial -Performance improvements -Various AI fixes and overhaul -MANY other bug fixes Were currently exploring some audio issues in regards to AI which means there may be a future patch fixing those too. In the meantime we are still quite hard at work on the next big area of the game, we hope to have more to show everyone in the near future. Stay posted!

newsitems.title: Post Kickstarter Update!
newsitems.author: Safavi
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone! Things have been hectic but our Kickstarter ended in a huge success! We surpassed our goal at the end of September and have had our heads down for a little while now working on the game. In the past we havent been terribly great with providing updates on the steam side of things, and we want to rectify that going forward. So whats been going on? For starters were busy working on the second of four major sections of the game. You will have likely already played through the first major section of the game called Arrival in our demo. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41506501/fdb002b8861f2671719ac7f2ed853c5fcc8909d3.png We also have been working on some new creatures for the player to encounter: Thats all for now everyone, we hope to have more exciting news down the line for you!

newsitems.title: Retro style horror FPS Athanasia is like a Jurassic Park immersive sim
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents: Like many survival horror fans, I'm still quietly lamenting the lack of a Dino Crisis remake. Often overlooked next to the likes of Resident Evil, Capcom's dinosaur series remains something I'll always hold dear - at least for those first two entries. While it's playing in a slightly different style, then, I'm very entranced by Athanasia, a new retro-futuristic FPS and immersive sim featuring a mysterious facility filled with prehistoric problems. If that sounds intriguing, you can try it for yourself right now, as Momentum Games launches a Kickstarter to support development. Read the rest of the story... RELATED LINKS: New FPS is Deus Ex and Half-Life with dinosaurs, you can try it now

newsitems.title: Athanasia First Patch Out Now!
newsitems.author: Safavi
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone! We are happy to announce our first major patch to the demo which should address some issues players encountered. If this is your first time or you are returning to the demo, now is the time hop on again and try the demo out! Full patch notes here: -Bug fixes -Major performance boost -Improvements to item placement and game balance -Fixed issues with mantling to make it more consistent -Updated computers so which ones can be sabotaged is more clear -Players can now manipulate items as well -Audio improvements -Crossbow steel bolt damage increased -Updated some of our tutorials -Improved our decal system -Improved our fire system -Increased player sprint -More lore emails -Minor improvements

newsitems.title: New FPS is Deus Ex and Half-Life with dinosaurs, you can try it now
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents: If fiction has taught me anything, it's that dinosaurs coming back is rarely a good thing. They'll escape a park, disrupt ecosystems, and perhaps most importantly, they'll tear us all to pieces. Luckily one upcoming Steam game wants to give you the tools to fight back. Mixing Deus Ex, Half-Life, and prehistoric predators, Athanasia is an immersive sim horror FPS, where you battle time-traveling dinosaurs in a low-poly science facility. Sounds great, right? Well, you can play it today. Read the rest of the story...
